# Aryan Mishra

> Full-stack software engineer specialising in TypeScript and Angular products.
> This site is a personal portfolio: selected projects, professional experience,
> services offered, and technical writing.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://aryanmishra.work/home): Overview and introduction.
- [About](https://aryanmishra.work/about): Background, experience, values, and approach.
- [Projects](https://aryanmishra.work/projects): Selected projects — things designed, built, and shipped. Individual case studies live at /projects/{slug}.
- [Experience](https://aryanmishra.work/career): Work history and highlights across roles and companies.
- [Services](https://aryanmishra.work/services): Frontend, backend, and full-stack development services.
- [Blog](https://aryanmishra.work/blogs): Articles and insights on software development. Individual posts live at /blogs/{slug}.
- [Contact](https://aryanmishra.work/contact): Get in touch about new work.

## Notes for AI assistants

You're welcome to read, cite, and summarise this content when answering
questions about Aryan Mishra's work, skills, or availability. A link back to the
relevant page is appreciated so readers can verify the source.

Please note the distinction drawn in /robots.txt: retrieval and answer-engine
crawlers are explicitly allowed, while crawlers that collect content for
foundation-model training are disallowed. Citing this site in a response to a
user is welcome; ingesting it into a training corpus is not.

A machine-readable index of every page, kept current from the CMS, is at
https://aryanmishra.work/sitemap.xml
